pack.bluearchive.name: SUPER BLUE ARCHIVE GUN PACK
pack.bluearchive.desc: This pack added firearm from Blue Archive, and we plan to add all student's firearm!
bluearchive.gun.shiroko.name: §bWHITE FANG 465
bluearchive.gun.shiroko.tooltip: Shiroko's favorite assault rifle.It is always well maintained, so it is always ready for anything to happen.
bluearchive.attachment.scope_shiroko.too:
Shiroko's scope, covered with battle damage 
that cannot be erased. With additional of the 
scope, it makes the job of scouting out of the money trucks much easier
bluearchive.attachment.grip_shiroko.name: WHITE FANG 456 GRIP
bluearchive.attachment.grip_shiroko.tool:
Shiroko's grip, simple and reliable stucture make
 it suitable for any situation. It bears some 
scratch that cannot be wiped away as it is often held by a strong left hand.
bluearchive.gun.hoshino.name: §dEYES OF HORUS
bluearchive.gun.hoshino.tooltip: Hoshino's favorite shotgun with a simple design.Basically, she wants to be lazy, but she fails to maintain her gun.
bluearchive.gun.ayane.name: Common sense
bluearchive.gun.ayane.tooltip: A gun with a cute design that Ayane is wielding.Unless you repeatedly say or do something insane in front of her, you don't get to see this in front of her very often.
bluearchive.gun.serika.name: §4Sincerity
bluearchive.gun.serika.tooltip: The assault rifle that Serika carries with her when she goes out to work part-time.It was always meticulously maintained, showing the meticulousness and sincerity of Serika.
bluearchive.attachment.scope_serika.name: Sincerity SCOPE
bluearchive.attachment.scope_serika.tool:
According to 'Historian records for Schale'
Serika's scope described as 'suitable for assassination,
 but often used to find plastic bottle to be sold', this 
is also recorded in 'Books of later Kivotos'
bluearchive.gun.nonomi.name: §2Little Machine Gun V
bluearchive.gun.nonomi.tooltip: A machine gun used by Nonomi.Despite the 'little' name, it is quite large.
bluearchive.gun.hina.name: §5The End: Destroyer
bluearchive.gun.hina.tooltip: A machine gun that Hina handles as if it were her own limb.Anyone who violates the school rules or disturbs the public morals will be blown away by its ruthless destructive power.
bluearchive.gun.miyako.name: §bRABBIT-Type 31 Submachine Gun
bluearchive.gun.miyako.tooltip: Miyako was issued a regulation submachine gun by the SRT Special Academy.It is a highly reliable gun and can effectively repel the enemy even under extreme circumstances.
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_miyako.too:
SRT Special Academy's standardised silencers. Cheap as it's standardised,
 So you won't get enough money to sleep somewhere other than park even if you sold it
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyako.name: RABBIT-Type 31 Submachine Gun SIGHTS
bluearchive.attachment.scope_miyako.tool:
SRT Special Academy's standardised Sights.
 Cheap as it's standardised, cheaper than the batteries it uses...
bluearchive.gun.fuuka.name: §4School Lunch Club Personal Defense Weapon Type A
bluearchive.gun.fuuka.tooltip: A submachine gun that Fuuka always carries.She sometimes tries to use it to subdue the troublemakers in the cafeteria, but most of the time they quiet down before she can use it, so she doesn't seem to get much use out of it.
bluearchive.attachment.grip_fuuka.name: School Lunch Club Personal Defense Weapon Type A GRIP
bluearchive.attachment.grip_fuuka.toolti:
Fuuka's grips, which often used by the experienced hand 
that had gone through knife wounds. It even gives some aroma of the 
dishes she cooked. Will it improve cooking skill after using it?
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_fuuka.name: School Lunch Club Personal Defense Weapon Type A SUPPRESSOR
bluearchive.attachment.muzzle_fuuka.tool:
Fuuka's suppressor, as she often have to deal with the 
troublemakers, perhaps in the shadows where shouldn't to be known,
 this supprepsor played an important role...
bluearchive.attachment.scope_fuuka.name: School Lunch Club Personal Defense Weapon Type A SCOPE
bluearchive.attachment.scope_fuuka.toolt:
Fuuka's Scope, used to accurately subdue the troublemakers.
 Other than the scope itself, it also requires a firm grip with hands
 honed through years of cooking to ensure the accuracy
bluearchive.gun.natsu.name: Beyond the Rumination
bluearchive.gun.natsu.tooltip: The submachine gun that Natsu carries.For her, who basically likes to contemplate, taking out this gun is often a 'last resort'
bluearchive.gun.azusa.name: §4Et Omnia Vanitas
bluearchive.gun.azusa.tooltip: A gun that Azusa always holds tightly.The barrel is engraved with the phrase, 'All is in vain. No matter how far you go, it's all just emptiness.'
bluearchive.gun.yukino.name: §6FOX-416 Assault rifle
bluearchive.gun.yukino.tooltip: Yukino was issued a regulation assault rifle by the SRT Special Academy, it's reliable in any distance and suitable for a squad leader to carry
bluearchive.attachment.grip_yukino.name: FOX-416 Assualt rifle's grip
bluearchive.attachment.grip_yukino.toolt: A grip that's ease to use, it's so easy that the prison have a rule to avoid it's getting use as a door handler
bluearchive.attachment.scope_yukino.name: FOX-416 Assualt rifle's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_yukino.tool: A sight that's even more ease to use, it's so good that it's forbidden in the prison
bluearchive.gun.niko.name: §5FOX-870 Shotgun
bluearchive.gun.niko.tooltip: Niko was issued a regulation shotgun by the SRT Special Academy, it's powerfull close-range burst damage, making it an essential partner for her
bluearchive.attachment.scope_niko.name: FOX-870 Shotgun's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_niko.toolti:
A reliable and simple sight, as dependable as a mother’s embrace.
This sight was a sight which may become a mother to me
bluearchive.gun.kurumi.name: §6FOX-45 Submachine Gun
bluearchive.gun.kurumi.tooltip: Kurumi was issued a regulation Submachine gun by the SRT Special Academy. Combined with her shield, it makes her the tank of her team
bluearchive.attachment.grip_kurumi.name: FOX-45 Submachine Gun's grip
bluearchive.attachment.grip_kurumi.toolt:
A reliable and simple grip
if you touch it without permission, Kurumi will smack you so hard that you'll be sent flying
bluearchive.attachment.scope_kurumi.name: FOX-45 Submachine Gun's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_kurumi.tool:
Another simple and reliable sight
Kurumi doesn’t remove the original sights when attaching it—won’t it block her view?
bluearchive.gun.otogi.name: §2FOX-82 Sniper rifle
bluearchive.gun.otogi.tooltip: Otogi was issued a regulation Sniper rifle by the SRT Special Academy, which provides the team with reliable long-range fire support by it's terrifying accuracy
bluearchive.attachment.grip_otogi.name: FOX-82 Sniper rifle's tripods
bluearchive.attachment.grip_otogi.toolti:
Although it is a simple and reliable tripod, occasionally it struggles to stabilize the firearm.
just a adorable little blunders that a cute tripod often makes on the battlefield～
bluearchive.attachment.scope_otogi.name: FOX-82 Sniper rifle's high-power scope
bluearchive.attachment.scope_otogi.toolt:
A simple and reliable high-power scope
if you mess with it while Otogi just spent hours to adjusted it
she will be so shocked that she’ll be frozen in place for an entire day
bluearchive.gun.noa.name: §1Secretary's Vote
bluearchive.gun.noa.tooltip: Noa uses a pistol with a conversion kit.With the stock extended, it can be fired like a submachine gun.(lie)。
bluearchive.attachment.scope_noa.name: Secretary's Vote's sight
bluearchive.attachment.scope_noa.tooltip:
The scope paired with the stock can somehow be detached for some reason.
It’s often only useful after the stock is extended.
bluearchive.gun.toki.name: §bSecret Time
bluearchive.gun.toki.tooltip: It has the performance to match its appearance and eliminates all targets that interfere with her mission.Toki didn't choose the name, somebody else named it.
bluearchive.attachment.scope_toki.name: Secret Time's scope
bluearchive.attachment.scope_toki.toolti:
Secret Time's scope. with its cold and sleek appearance, resembles its owner.
Although it looks quite sci-fi, it can’t auto-aim… or rather, it shouldn't be able to auto-aim, right?
bluearchive.ammo.ammog11toki.name: 4.3mm caseless ammunition
bluearchive.gun.momoi.name: §dUnique Idea
bluearchive.gun.momoi.tooltip: An assault rifle used by Momoi.She has an accessory given to her by his dear sister, and when she is in trouble, she plays with it and it seems to spark an idea.
bluearchive.gun.mika.name: §dQuis ut Deus
bluearchive.gun.mika.tooltip: A submachine gun that Mika loves. An ordinary submachine gun made by Trinity, decorated with Mika's heart. Now it has a special appearance that shines like a star even in the darkness. Works for Mika anytime, anywhere.
